name: sure-aio-alpha
description: Sure Alpha is the testing lane for the Sure AIO Unraid package. It tracks upstream [code]we-promise/sure[/code] alpha prereleases and includes alpha-only wrapper patches before they are promoted or upstreamed. Testing / Unstable This template is meant for testing and local validation, not primary household finance data. Upstream alpha releases may include migrations or behavior changes that are not compatible with stable. Keep backups and do not point this container at your stable [code]sure-aio[/code] appdata. Alpha customizations - Raises Sure NDJSON import defaults to [code]250MB[/code] and [code]1,000,000[/code] rows. - Exposes [code]SURE_IMPORT_MAX_NDJSON_SIZE_MB[/code] and [code]SURE_IMPORT_MAX_ROWS[/code] for larger alpha import testing. - Runs strict SureImport preflight before publish so blocked imports show specific errors during alpha testing. - Adds a self-hosted admin reset UI/task for clearing one selected family workspace before a fresh Sure NDJSON import. - Adds temporary split-line and transfer route-parity import support for Enhanced NDJSON proof packages. - Uses a separate alpha tag namespace, Web UI port, and appdata root from stable. Quick Install 1. In Unraid, install this alpha template separately from stable. 2. Generate a secret with [code]openssl rand -hex 64[/code] and paste it into [code]Secret Key Base[/code]. 3. Leave the default alpha appdata paths unless you have a deliberate test directory. 4. Wait for initialization, then open [code]http://SERVER_IP:3001[/code] or your mapped port. Data paths (default) - [code]/mnt/user/appdata/sure-aio-alpha/system[/code] - [code]/mnt/user/appdata/sure-aio-alpha/postgres[/code] - [code]/mnt/user/appdata/sure-aio-alpha/redis[/code]

paths.name: App Volumes - Postgres DB
paths.description: Internal PostgreSQL database storage mapped externally so you don't lose data.

paths.name: [SSL] Custom CA Certificate Mount
paths.description: Optional host path to a PEM CA certificate file for trusting self-signed or internal HTTPS services. Leave blank unless you need private CA support.

variables.name: Secret Key Base
variables.description: Critical: Run 'openssl rand -hex 64' in your Unraid terminal and paste the randomized hash here.

variables.name: [Internal] Self Hosted Mode
variables.description: Internal wrapper flag required for Sure self-hosted mode. Leave unchanged.

variables.name: [Internal] Legacy Self Hosting Alias
variables.description: Legacy upstream alias for self-hosted mode. Usually leave blank because SELF_HOSTED=true is already set by this wrapper.

variables.name: [Alpha] Sure NDJSON Upload Limit MB
variables.description: Alpha-only Sure import NDJSON upload limit in megabytes. Lower it if this test instance has constrained storage or memory.

variables.name: [Alpha] Sure Import Max Rows
variables.description: Alpha-only Sure import row limit used by web, API, and preflight paths.

variables.name: App Domain
variables.description: The domain your Sure instance is hosted at (used for email links).

variables.name: App URL
variables.description: Optional full external base URL including scheme, such as 'https://finance.example.com'. Useful for advanced SSO flows that need an absolute callback or issuer URL.

variables.name: Onboarding State
variables.description: Controls user registration. Use 'open', 'closed', or 'invite_only'.

variables.name: Require Invite Code
variables.description: Optional global gate for account registration. Set to 'true' to require invite codes for sign-up.

variables.name: Require Email Confirmation
variables.description: Set to 'false' if you explicitly want to skip email confirmation for new accounts. Leave enabled for the safer default.

variables.name: Assume SSL
variables.description: Leave 'false' for direct LAN access. Set to 'true' only when Sure sits behind a SSL-terminating reverse proxy.

variables.name: Force SSL Redirects
variables.description: Leave 'false' for the default Unraid install over plain HTTP. Set to 'true' only if you want direct HTTP requests redirected to HTTPS.

variables.name: [Proxy] Referrer Policy
variables.description: Browser Referrer-Policy header used by Rails origin checks. Keep 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin' for reverse proxies; avoid 'no-referrer' because it can make browsers send Origin: null and break login POSTs.

variables.name: [Proxy] CSRF Origin Check
variables.description: Leave 'true' unless your reverse proxy, Cloudflare path, browser, or privacy middleware still forces login POSTs to send Origin: null. Set to 'false' only as an advanced compatibility escape hatch; Rails CSRF token validation remains enabled.

variables.name: [SSL] Custom CA File
variables.description: Optional in-container path to a PEM CA certificate file. If you use the provided mount above, set this to '/certs/custom-ca.pem'.

variables.name: [SSL] Override Global CA Bundle
variables.description: Optional full CA bundle path for advanced Ruby/OpenSSL trust overrides. Usually leave blank and use SSL_CA_FILE instead.

variables.name: [SSL] Verify Remote Certificates
variables.description: Leave 'true' for production. Set to 'false' only for temporary testing against broken or self-signed HTTPS endpoints.

variables.name: [SSL] Debug Logging
variables.description: Set to 'true' to log detailed outbound SSL trust and certificate diagnostics.

variables.name: [Legal] Privacy Policy URL
variables.description: Optional external privacy-policy URL shown by the app when provided.

variables.name: [Legal] Terms of Service URL
variables.description: Optional external terms-of-service URL shown by the app when provided.

variables.name: [External DB] DB Host Override
variables.description: Optional external PostgreSQL host or container name. Example: '192.168.1.50' or 'postgres-shared' on a custom Docker network.

variables.name: [External DB] DB Port Override
variables.description: Optional external PostgreSQL port. Example: '5432'.

variables.name: [External DB] DB Name Override
variables.description: Optional external PostgreSQL database name. Leave blank to keep Sure's normal default database name.

variables.name: [External DB] DB User Override
variables.description: Optional external PostgreSQL username. This user must already exist on your external database.

variables.name: [External DB] DB Password Override
variables.description: Optional password for the external PostgreSQL user above.

variables.name: [External DB] Redis URL Override
variables.description: Optional external Redis URL. Example: 'redis://192.168.1.50:6379/1' or 'redis://:password@redis-host:6379/1'.

variables.name: [External Redis] Sentinel Hosts
variables.description: Optional Redis Sentinel hosts, comma-separated like 'host1:26379,host2:26379'. Takes precedence over REDIS_URL when set.

variables.name: [External Redis] Sentinel Master
variables.description: Redis Sentinel master name.

variables.name: [External Redis] Sentinel Username
variables.description: Redis Sentinel username if your Sentinel deployment requires authentication.

variables.name: [External Redis] Sentinel Password
variables.description: Redis password used for Sentinel-backed Redis deployments.

variables.name: [System] Product Name
variables.description: Custom product name in UI.

variables.name: [System] Brand Name
variables.description: Custom brand name in UI.

variables.name: [System] Default UI Layout
variables.description: Choose the initial layout for new sessions. Use 'dashboard' for the standard app or 'intro' for the intro-first experience.

variables.name: [DB Encryption] Primary Key
variables.description: Optional explicit Rails encryption primary key. Leave blank unless you deliberately manage separate Active Record encryption keys outside SECRET_KEY_BASE.

variables.name: [DB Encryption] Deterministic Key
variables.description: Optional deterministic encryption key paired with the primary key above. Leave blank unless you already know your Rails encryption key material.

variables.name: [DB Encryption] Derivation Salt
variables.description: Optional key-derivation salt for Rails encryption. Leave blank unless you manage custom encryption keys yourself.

variables.name: [AI] OpenAI / Ollama Token
variables.description: OpenAI-compatible API key. Get OpenAI keys from platform.openai.com/api-keys. If using local Ollama, enter any non-empty placeholder such as 'ollama-local'.

variables.name: [AI] OpenAI URI Base
variables.description: Leave blank for official OpenAI. For local LLMs, enter your endpoint (e.g., 'http://ollama:11434/v1').

variables.name: [AI] Model Name
variables.description: If using Ollama, you MUST define the model here (e.g., 'llama3.1:13b' or 'gemma2:7b').

variables.name: [AI] Categorization Provider
variables.description: Optional provider override used only for transaction categorization. Example: 'openai' or 'ollama'. If blank, Sure uses its normal AI provider behavior.

variables.name: [AI] Categorization Model
variables.description: Optional model override used only for categorization, such as 'gemma2:7b'.

variables.name: [AI] Chat Provider
variables.description: Optional provider override used only for chat-assistant requests. Example: 'openai' or 'ollama'.

variables.name: [AI] Chat Model
variables.description: Optional model override used only for chat-assistant requests, such as 'gpt-4.1' or a local Ollama model.

variables.name: [AI] Request Timeout
variables.description: OpenAI-compatible request timeout in seconds. Raise this only if your provider or local LLM is slow to respond.

variables.name: [AI] JSON Mode Override
variables.description: Optional structured-output override. Valid values are '', 'strict', 'none', or 'json_object'. Set this only if you need to force Sure's OpenAI JSON behavior globally.

variables.name: [AI] Debug Logging
variables.description: Set to 'true' to enable verbose AI chat debugging in logs.

variables.name: [AI] Enable PDF Processing
variables.description: Leave 'true' for OpenAI or vision-capable providers. Set to 'false' only for OpenAI-compatible endpoints that do not support PDF or vision input.

variables.name: [AI] Supports Responses API
variables.description: Optional override for OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Use 'true' to force the Responses API or 'false' to force chat completions. Leave blank for upstream auto-detection.

variables.name: [AI] Context Window
variables.description: Optional total LLM context window in tokens. Lower this for small local models or raise it for larger cloud models.

variables.name: [AI] Max Response Tokens
variables.description: Optional tokens reserved for each model response. Leave blank for upstream defaults.

variables.name: [AI] Max History Tokens
variables.description: Optional explicit chat history token budget. Leave blank so Sure derives it from context, response, and system-prompt reserves.

variables.name: [AI] System Prompt Reserve
variables.description: Optional tokens reserved for Sure's system prompt and instructions. Leave blank for upstream defaults.

variables.name: [AI] Max Items Per Tool Call
variables.description: Optional maximum batch size for AI categorization and merchant-detection calls. Lower this for small local models.

variables.name: [AI] Vector Store Provider
variables.description: Optional document-search backend. Leave blank for the default path. Set to 'pgvector' to use PostgreSQL-based vectors or 'qdrant' for an external Qdrant server.

variables.name: [AI] Embedding Model
variables.description: Embedding model name used for document search. Example: 'nomic-embed-text'. This is required when you enable pgvector or qdrant-backed document search.

variables.name: [AI] Embedding Dimensions
variables.description: Embedding width for the selected model. Must match the provider output.

variables.name: [AI] Embedding URI Base
variables.description: Optional dedicated embeddings endpoint. Example: 'http://ollama:11434/v1'. If blank, Sure falls back to OPENAI_URI_BASE.

variables.name: [AI] Embedding Access Token
variables.description: Optional dedicated embeddings token. If blank, Sure falls back to OPENAI_ACCESS_TOKEN.

variables.name: [AI] Qdrant URL
variables.description: Optional external Qdrant endpoint for vector storage. Example: 'http://192.168.1.50:6333'.

variables.name: [AI] Qdrant API Key
variables.description: Optional Qdrant API key from your Qdrant Cloud or self-hosted auth configuration.

variables.name: [Ext. AI] Assistant Type
variables.description: Set to 'external' to route all chat to an external agent via MCP.

variables.name: [Ext. AI] Assistant URL
variables.description: URL for the external agent (e.g. https://your-openclaw/v1/chat/completions).

variables.name: [Ext. AI] Assistant Token
variables.description: Auth token expected by your external agent or gateway. Copy it from that service's dashboard or config.

variables.name: [Ext. AI] Agent ID
variables.description: Optional Agent ID for OpenClaw routing.

variables.name: [Ext. AI] Session Key
variables.description: Optional shared session key for remote agent conversation persistence. Leave blank so Sure-AIO derives isolated per-chat remote state.

variables.name: [Ext. AI] Allowed Emails
variables.description: Optional comma-separated allowlist of users permitted to use the external assistant.

variables.name: [Ext. AI] MCP User Email
variables.description: Required if using Ext. AI: Email of an existing Sure user.

variables.name: [Ext. AI] MCP API Token
variables.description: Required if using Ext. AI: Bearer token for agent callbacks to /mcp. Generate one with 'openssl rand -hex 32' in the Unraid terminal.

variables.name: [Telemetry] PostHog Key
variables.description: PostHog project API key from your PostHog project settings.

variables.name: [Telemetry] PostHog Host
variables.description: PostHog host URL. Example: 'https://us.i.posthog.com' or your self-hosted PostHog URL.

variables.name: [Telemetry] Langfuse Host
variables.description: Langfuse base URL for LLM observability. Example: 'https://cloud.langfuse.com' or your self-hosted Langfuse URL.

variables.name: [Telemetry] Langfuse Region
variables.description: Optional Langfuse region shortcut like 'us' or 'eu'. Use this only if you are not setting a custom Langfuse Host URL.

variables.name: [Telemetry] Langfuse Public Key
variables.description: Langfuse public key from your project settings.

variables.name: [Telemetry] Langfuse Secret Key
variables.description: Langfuse secret key from your project settings.

variables.name: [Telemetry] Sentry DSN
variables.description: Optional Sentry DSN if you want upstream exception reporting enabled for this instance.

variables.name: [Telemetry] Skylight Enabled
variables.description: Set to 'true' only if you intentionally use Skylight's hosted APM service. Default is 'false' for AIO installs so no external Skylight setup is required.

variables.name: [Telemetry] Skylight Auth Token
variables.description: Optional Skylight app authentication token. Only used when SKYLIGHT_ENABLED is true and you want to send APM data to your Skylight account.

variables.name: [Telemetry] Logtail API Key
variables.description: Optional Better Stack / Logtail source token from your log source settings.

variables.name: [Telemetry] Logtail Ingest Host
variables.description: Optional Logtail ingest host used with LOGTAIL_API_KEY.

variables.name: [Telemetry] Rails Log Level
variables.description: Application log verbosity. Use 'info' for normal operation or 'debug' for deeper troubleshooting.

variables.name: [Runtime] Rails/Sidekiq Thread Pool
variables.description: Optional worker thread count used by Puma, Sidekiq, and DB pool sizing. Leave blank for upstream default (3).

variables.name: [Runtime] Puma Worker Processes
variables.description: Optional Puma process count for the web service. Leave blank for upstream default (1).

variables.name: [Runtime] Sidekiq Web Username
variables.description: Optional username for /sidekiq dashboard basic auth. Leave blank to keep upstream default username ('sure').

variables.name: [Runtime] Sidekiq Web Password
variables.description: Optional password for /sidekiq dashboard basic auth. Leave blank to keep upstream default password ('sure').

variables.name: [Network] HTTPS Proxy
variables.description: Optional outbound HTTPS proxy URL (for advanced egress controls like Pipelock). Leave blank for normal direct outbound traffic.

variables.name: [Network] HTTP Proxy
variables.description: Optional outbound HTTP proxy URL. Leave blank unless your network requires a proxy.

variables.name: [Network] No Proxy Hosts
variables.description: Optional comma-separated hosts/domains that should bypass HTTP(S) proxy routing.

variables.name: [API] Exchange Rate Provider
variables.description: Optional exchange-rate provider override. If left blank, Sure uses its normal default and UI selection behavior.

variables.name: [API] Securities Provider
variables.description: Optional securities provider override. If left blank, Sure uses its normal default and UI selection behavior.

variables.name: [API] Securities Providers
variables.description: Optional comma-separated securities provider list. Example: 'yahoo_finance,binance_public,twelve_data'. Takes precedence over the single Securities Provider field when set.

variables.name: [API] Brandfetch Client ID
variables.description: Brandfetch client ID from your Brandfetch application or dashboard if you want merchant and bank logos.

variables.name: [API] Brandfetch High-Res Logos
variables.description: Optional env override for 120x120 Brandfetch logos. Set to 'true' to force high-res logos, 'false' to force standard size. Leave blank to keep the in-app toggle enabled.

variables.name: [API] Indexa API Token
variables.description: Optional global API token used by the Indexa Capital provider when account-level credentials are not configured.

variables.name: [API] Twelve Data Key
variables.description: Optional Twelve Data API key from twelvedata.com if you want exchange rates or securities from Twelve Data instead of Yahoo Finance.

variables.name: [API] Twelve Data URL Override
variables.description: Optional custom Twelve Data API base URL. Leave blank unless you are routing Twelve Data through a proxy or alternate endpoint.

variables.name: [API] Twelve Data Min Request Interval
variables.description: Optional minimum spacing between Twelve Data requests in seconds. Leave blank for upstream pacing.

variables.name: [API] Twelve Data Max Requests Per Minute
variables.description: Optional Twelve Data per-minute credit limit. Lower this if your plan is more restrictive than upstream defaults.

variables.name: [API] Tiingo API Key
variables.description: Optional Tiingo API key for securities pricing. Configure provider selection separately if you want Sure to use Tiingo.

variables.name: [API] Tiingo URL Override
variables.description: Optional custom Tiingo API base URL. Leave blank for normal public Tiingo access.

variables.name: [API] Tiingo Max Requests Per Hour
variables.description: Optional Tiingo hourly request cap used by Sure's rate limiter. Leave blank for upstream defaults.

variables.name: [API] EODHD API Key
variables.description: Optional EODHD API key for securities pricing, especially international ETF coverage. Configure provider selection separately if you want Sure to use EODHD.

variables.name: [API] EODHD URL Override
variables.description: Optional custom EODHD API base URL. Leave blank for normal public EODHD access.

variables.name: [API] EODHD Max Requests Per Day
variables.description: Optional EODHD daily request cap used by Sure's rate limiter. Leave blank for upstream defaults.

variables.name: [API] Alpha Vantage API Key
variables.description: Optional Alpha Vantage API key for securities pricing. Configure provider selection separately if you want Sure to use Alpha Vantage.

variables.name: [API] Alpha Vantage URL Override
variables.description: Optional custom Alpha Vantage API base URL. Leave blank for normal public Alpha Vantage access.

variables.name: [API] Alpha Vantage Max Requests Per Day
variables.description: Optional Alpha Vantage daily request cap used by Sure's rate limiter. Leave blank for upstream defaults.

variables.name: [API] MFAPI URL Override
variables.description: Optional custom MFAPI base URL for mutual-fund data. Leave blank for upstream defaults.

variables.name: [API] Binance Public URL Override
variables.description: Optional custom Binance public market-data base URL. Leave blank for upstream defaults.

variables.name: [API] Binance Egress IP Hint
variables.description: Optional public egress IP shown in the Binance setup UI so users know which IP to allowlist.

variables.name: [API] Yahoo Finance URL Override
variables.description: Optional custom Yahoo Finance API base URL. Leave blank for normal public Yahoo Finance access.

variables.name: [API] Yahoo Finance Max Retries
variables.description: Maximum retry attempts for Yahoo Finance requests before Sure gives up.

variables.name: [API] Yahoo Finance Retry Interval
variables.description: Seconds to wait between Yahoo Finance retry attempts.

variables.name: [API] Yahoo Finance Min Request Interval
variables.description: Optional minimum spacing between Yahoo Finance requests in seconds. Leave blank to keep upstream defaults.

variables.name: [Sync] Auto Sync Enabled
variables.description: Container-level override for Sure's scheduled sync job. Use '1' to keep it enabled or '0' to disable automatic syncs globally.

variables.name: [Sync] Auto Sync Time
variables.description: Daily auto-sync time in 24-hour HH:MM format.

variables.name: [Sync] Auto Sync Timezone
variables.description: Timezone used with AUTO_SYNC_TIME. Example: 'America/Denver'.

variables.name: [Sync] SimpleFIN Include Pending
variables.description: Set to '0' to exclude pending SimpleFIN transactions. If set here, upstream disables the corresponding Sync setting in the Sure UI.

variables.name: [Sync] SimpleFIN Raw Debug Logs
variables.description: Set to 'true' to log raw SimpleFIN payloads for debugging. This can expose sensitive data and create noisy logs.

variables.name: [Sync] SimpleFIN Credit Overpayment Heuristic
variables.description: Optional override for SimpleFIN liability overpayment detection. Set to 'false' to disable the heuristic globally.

variables.name: [Sync] Plaid Include Pending
variables.description: Set to '0' to exclude pending Plaid transactions. If set here, upstream disables the corresponding Sync setting in the Sure UI.

variables.name: [Sync] Lunchflow Include Pending
variables.description: Set to 'true' to include pending transactions in Lunchflow sync requests.

variables.name: [Sync] Lunchflow Raw Debug Logs
variables.description: Set to 'true' to log raw Lunchflow payloads for debugging. This can expose sensitive data and create noisy logs.

variables.name: [Auth] Local Login Enabled
variables.description: Set to 'false' to disable local email/password login and move users toward SSO-only auth.

variables.name: [Auth] Local Admin Override
variables.description: If local login is disabled, set to 'true' to let super admins keep local login as an emergency backdoor.

variables.name: [Auth] JIT SSO Mode
variables.description: SSO behavior for first-time users: 'create_and_link' creates accounts automatically, 'link_only' requires an existing user.

variables.name: [Auth] Allowed OIDC Domains
variables.description: Optional comma-separated email domains allowed for JIT SSO account creation.

variables.name: [Alpha Auth] WebAuthn Relying Party ID
variables.description: Alpha-only passkey/WebAuthn relying party ID. Usually your registrable domain, such as 'example.com'. This only configures browser trust; add passkeys inside Sure from Settings > Security after enabling authenticator-app 2FA. Changing this after registering credentials can make existing passkeys unusable.

variables.name: [Alpha Auth] WebAuthn Allowed Origins
variables.description: Alpha-only comma-separated WebAuthn origins including scheme and host, such as 'https://finance.example.com'. This only configures browser trust; add passkeys inside Sure from Settings > Security after enabling authenticator-app 2FA.

variables.name: [Auth] Provider Source
variables.description: Leave blank for normal YAML/env-backed provider loading. Set to 'db' if you want upstream's database-backed SSO provider admin UI.

variables.name: [Auth] OIDC Client ID
variables.description: OIDC client ID from your identity provider app registration, such as Authentik, Authelia, Keycloak, or Zitadel.

variables.name: [Auth] OIDC Client Secret
variables.description: OIDC client secret from the same identity provider app registration.

variables.name: [Auth] OIDC Issuer
variables.description: OIDC issuer URL. Example: 'https://auth.example.com/application/o/sure/' or your provider's issuer endpoint.

variables.name: [Auth] OIDC Redirect URI
variables.description: OIDC redirect URI registered with your provider. Example: 'https://finance.example.com/auth/openid_connect/callback'.

variables.name: [Auth] OIDC Button Label
variables.description: Optional custom sign-in button label for the default OIDC provider.

variables.name: [Auth] OIDC Button Icon
variables.description: Optional icon slug for the default OIDC sign-in button.

variables.name: [Auth] Google OAuth Client ID

variables.name: [Auth] Google Button Label
variables.description: Optional custom label for the Google sign-in button.

variables.name: [Auth] Google Button Icon

variables.name: [Auth] GitHub OAuth Client ID
variables.description: Optional GitHub OAuth client ID from your GitHub OAuth App settings if you want a dedicated GitHub sign-in provider.

variables.name: [Auth] GitHub OAuth Client Secret
variables.description: Optional GitHub OAuth client secret from the same GitHub OAuth App.

variables.name: [Auth] GitHub Button Label
variables.description: Optional custom label for the GitHub sign-in button.

variables.name: [Auth] GitHub Button Icon
variables.description: Optional icon slug for the GitHub sign-in button.

variables.description: Optional named Keycloak OIDC provider client ID for upstream multi-provider auth.yml mode.

variables.name: [Auth:Keycloak] Client Secret
variables.description: Optional named Keycloak OIDC provider client secret for upstream multi-provider auth.yml mode.
